description: ADR 0050 §1, RFC 7518 §4.7.1, RFC 7516 §11.4: the reverse relabel: the dir-no-protected-header triple presented as an A128GCMKW key wrap (iv and tag in the shared header, its ciphertext as encrypted_key), with the same triple as content. GCMKW with an unprotected alg is not a direct mode, so the header rule does not apply; the key unwraps to the dir plaintext, under which the copied content does not open (checked with Node.js 24.21.0 node:crypto (OpenSSL 3.5.8)): the uniform DecryptionFailed, never a plaintext
